draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Perumbavoor, Kerala's plywood capital! The state's largest centres for the timber trade and wood industries are right here on the Periyar basin.
draft.hungryLine: Perumbavoor is the place for dirt-cheap north Indian street food, and Apsara Restaurant is famous for its mutton biriyani.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Town Juma Masjid is a 2 min walk. For a half-day trip, Kodanad's elephant centre is about 11 km away.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Head out to Panieli Poru Waterfalls near Perumbavoor.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kodanad, 11 km away, raises baby elephants. Four to six young ones are brought in and trained every year.

legends.title: When elephants were caught
legends.body: Elephants captured in the Malayatoor forests were once trained at Kodanad. The capturing ended in 1977, but the centre still trains young elephants.

legends.title: Biriyani without a fridge
legends.body: Apsara's mutton biriyani is called legendary. Locals say they don't use any refrigeration and everything is served fresh.

tips.title: Pick busy street stalls.
tips.body: Street food here is dirt cheap, but hygiene can be a serious issue.

tips.title: Plan Kodanad as a half day.
tips.body: It's about 11 km from town, with direct buses or taxis from Aluva.

story.title: A mission begins
story.body: The Evangelistic Association of the East was founded in 1924 as the first missionary association of the Syriac Orthodox Church. It's headquartered at Perumbavoor and was registered in 1949.

story.title: The last elephant capture
story.body: Elephant capturing in the Malayatoor forests ended in 1977. Kodanad became a rescue and training centre for young elephants.

story.title: A growing town
story.body: The 2011 census counted 28,110 people in Perumbavoor. It's the headquarters of Perumbavoor taluk.

story.title: Plywood capital
story.body: Timber and wood industries made Perumbavoor Kerala's plywood capital. It's now one of the state's main destinations for workers from West Bengal, Assam, Bihar and Odisha.

food.name: Apsara Restaurant
food.detail: Order the mutton biriyani, made fresh with no refrigeration
